LandingPage.introBoxTitle: Need to move faster? Request a direct introduction (€15)
LandingPage.introBoxBody: Rather than waiting, a borrower can request direct contact with an investor (individual, company or organization) and vice versa. Once the request is paid, contact details are exchanged immediately both ways.
LandingPage.introBoxDisclaimer: Lentific provides the contact; what happens next between the two parties takes place outside the platform and is not our responsibility.
